noAnswer.title: No answer recorded

notice.channelBody: Asks if you're okay when SafeRide notices unusual movement during a journey.
notice.body: SafeRide noticed unusual movement. Tap "I'm safe" if you're okay.
notice.noAnswer: You didn't answer in time. No one has been alerted.
notice.off: Notifications are off, so SafeRide can only ask if you're okay while it is on screen.

escalation.waitingForConnection: Your trusted contacts have not been alerted. This phone is offline, so the request is saved here and will be sent when it reconnects.
escalation.waitingForServer: Your trusted contacts have not been alerted yet. The request reached SafeRide's server, which hasn't answered.
escalation.sending: SafeRide is trying to alert your trusted contacts.

accepted.one: The notification service accepted an alert for one contact. SafeRide can't tell whether it arrived or was read.
accepted.other: The notification service accepted alerts for {count} contacts. SafeRide can't tell whether they arrived or were read.

escalation.failed: The alert couldn't be sent to anyone.
escalation.noRecipients: Nobody was alerted: none of your trusted contacts can receive alerts yet. Invite them from Trusted Contacts.
escalation.rejected: Nobody was alerted. SafeRide's server didn't send this alert.
escalation.serviceUnavailable: Your trusted contacts could not be alerted: SafeRide's alert service isn't available. Nothing was sent to anyone. The record stays on this phone. If you need help, contact someone yourself.

search.offline: Search needs a connection. You can still tap the map, or type the place in the form.
search.failed: Search isn't available right now. You can still tap the map.

route.noRoute: No road route was found between these places. They're saved, and you can still plan the journey.
route.offline: The route can't load without a connection. Your places are kept, and you can still plan the journey.
route.unavailable: The route preview isn't available right now. Your places are kept, and you can still plan the journey.

location.denied: SafeRide needs your permission to use your location here.

contacts.heading: Saved numbers

guide.title: Safety Guide
guide.intro: General advice for getting around safely. It is saved in the app, so it is here even without a connection.

before.title: Before you ride
before.tip1: Check that the car, its plate and the driver match what you booked before you get in.
before.tip2: Tell someone you trust where you are going and when you expect to arrive.
before.tip3: Wait for your ride somewhere public and well lit.
before.tip4: Make sure your phone is charged.

during.title: During the ride
during.tip1: Sit in the back and wear your seat belt.
during.tip2: Follow the route on your own map app if you can.
during.tip3: Keep personal details, like your home address, to yourself.
during.tip4: If something feels wrong, ask to stop somewhere busy and get out.

after.title: When you arrive
after.tip1: Let the person you told know that you have arrived.
after.tip2: Check you have your belongings before the car leaves.
after.tip3: Report anything that worried you to the ride service.

emergency.title: In an emergency
emergency.tip1: Call the emergency number for where you are.
emergency.tip2: Give your location: a street, a landmark or a shop nearby.
emergency.tip3: Stay on the line and follow the instructions you are given.

journeys.title: Journey Safety
journeys.intro: Planning ahead gives you a clear record of where you are going and when. Telling the people you trust is up to you.

can.title: What SafeRide does today
can.plan: Lets you plan a journey: where from, where to and when.
can.review: Shows you the details to check before you save them.
can.checklist: Asks you to confirm a safety checklist before each journey starts.
can.route: Records your route, speed and distance while a journey you started is in progress, with your permission.
can.status: Keeps your journeys in your account; you start each one and mark it completed or cancelled yourself.
can.check: Asks if you're okay when it notices unusual movement, on screen or as a notification.
can.share: Lets you share your location or a journey in progress through a private link you control.

cannot.title: Not available yet
cannot.alerts: Alerting your trusted contacts, calling emergency services, or calling anyone for you.

emergency.title: Emergency Information
emergency.warning: Call emergency services only in a real emergency: when someone's life, health or safety is at risk, or there is a fire or a crime happening. A needless call can delay help for someone else.

choose.title: Which country are you in?
choose.body: Emergency numbers are different in each country. Choose the one you're in now; SafeRide doesn't guess it.

about.police: A crime, or danger to someone's safety.
about.ambulance: A medical emergency or a serious injury.
about.fire: A fire, smoke, or someone trapped who needs rescue.
about.roadSecurity: Help on the highways between cities.

emergency.callNote: Call opens your phone app with the number ready. You press call yourself, or cancel. SafeRide can't see whether the call connects or is answered, and it sends nothing to the emergency service.
emergency.secondary: Only foreign governments' travel advice lists this number. Confirm it locally.
emergency.checked: Checked on {date} against these sources (an official body, or a newspaper reporting one):

unavailable.title: No checked numbers yet
unavailable.body: SafeRide hasn't verified the emergency numbers for {country}. Ask locally for the emergency number where you are.

opened.title: Your phone app opened

invalidNumber.title: This number can't be dialled from SafeRide

missing.none: SafeRide has no checked number of its own for {services} in {country}.

invite.notLinked: To receive alerts, this contact needs SafeRide on their own phone and this invite code. SafeRide can't reach a phone number on its own.
invite.codeNote: Give this code to your contact yourself. They enter it in SafeRide, under Safety. It works once, until {date}.
invite.acceptNote: By accepting, you agree to receive alerts if this person doesn't answer a SafeRide safety check. You'll see their name and, if they added one, their phone number, but never their location.
invite.accepted: You're now a trusted contact of {name}.

alerts.channelBody: When someone who made you a trusted contact doesn't answer a safety check.
alerts.suddenDeceleration: SafeRide noticed a sudden slowdown during {name}'s journey, and got no answer to its safety check. The journey was still in progress when the alert was sent.
alerts.prolongedStop: SafeRide noticed a long stop during {name}'s journey, and got no answer to its safety check. The journey was still in progress when the alert was sent.
alerts.caution: This doesn't confirm that anything happened. SafeRide hasn't contacted emergency services and doesn't know where they are. Try reaching them yourself.

empty.title: No alerts
empty.body: When someone who made you a trusted contact doesn't answer a safety check, it shows here.

failed.title: Alerts couldn't be loaded

connections.heading: Connected people
connections.notice: A connection links your SafeRide account with someone else's. It shares nothing by itself: no phone number, no location and no journeys. Sharing your location stays your own choice, by a link you make.
connections.stale: You're offline, so this list may be out of date.

empty.title: No one connected yet

failed.title: Your connections couldn't be loaded
failed.body: Check your connection and try again.

invites.heading: Invitations
invites.message: {name} invited you to connect on SafeRide. Open this private link within 3 days: {link}

created.title: Invite ready
created.body: Anyone with the link can accept it, once. Send it only to the person you mean.

invites.cancelled: Invite cancelled. Its link no longer works.

cancelConfirm.title: Cancel this invite?
cancelConfirm.body: Its link will stop working. Anyone who already has it will see that it can no longer be used.

removeConfirm.title: Remove {name}?
removeConfirm.body: This ends the connection for both of you, straight away. It can't undo anything already seen, copied or saved. A location or journey link you sent is separate: this doesn't stop it, so stop it in Sharing if you need to.

removed.title: {name} removed
removed.body: The connection has ended for both of you. Any sharing link you sent is still running until you stop it.

manageScreen.title: Connection
manageScreen.separate: Sharing your location is separate from a connection: it happens only through a link you make, and ending one never ends the other.

gone.title: This connection has ended
gone.body: It was removed, from this phone or by the other person.

liveLocation.title: Live location: no
liveLocation.body: Only through a link you choose to send.

journeyHistory.title: Your journeys: no
journeyHistory.body: Your past and planned journeys stay in your account.

gpsHistory.title: Recorded routes: no
gpsHistory.body: A route you recorded stays in your account.

emergencyInformation.title: Emergency information: no
emergencyInformation.body: Nothing about your safety checks reaches them.

safetyAlerts.title: Safety alerts: not available
safetyAlerts.body: SafeRide can't alert anyone yet, so this person won't be told if you need help.

accept.title: Accept an invite
accept.entryNote: Paste the invite link someone sent you. Accepting it connects the account you're signed in to.
accept.meansName: You each see the other's name, in your Trusted Contacts.
accept.meansNothing: Neither of you sees the other's location or journeys.
accept.meansEnd: Either of you can end it at any time.
accept.onlyIfKnown: Only accept an invite from someone you know. SafeRide doesn't verify names.

done.title: Connected with {name}
done.body: Nothing else is shared between you.

signedOut.title: Sign in first
signedOut.body: An invite is accepted with your SafeRide account. Sign in or create one, then open the invite link again.

noLongerValid.title: This invite can't be used
noLongerValid.body: It may have expired, been used or been cancelled. Ask for a new one.

ownInvite.title: This is your own invite
ownInvite.body: Send it to the person you want to connect with.

alreadyConnected.title: You're already connected
alreadyConnected.body: You can see this person in Trusted Contacts.

profileMissing.title: Your profile isn't ready
profileMissing.body: Open your profile, save your name, and try again.

tooMany.title: Too many for now

offline.title: Couldn't reach SafeRide

unavailable.title: Not available yet
unavailable.body: SafeRide can't do this right now, and nothing was changed. Try again later.

help.title: Get help
help.none: SafeRide can't call anyone or alert your contacts for you. These are the ways to reach help yourself.

open.title: No answer was recorded at {time}
open.body: That doesn't mean anything happened, and nobody has been contacted: SafeRide can't alert anyone or call for help. If you're okay, say so. If you need help, use the options below.

share.heading: Share where you are
share.note: Only if you choose to: SafeRide makes a private link, and you send it yourself. Nothing is shared until you start it.

people.heading: Your people
people.none: You haven't added anyone yet. Saved numbers and connected people appear here.
people.cannotAlert: SafeRide can't alert connected people for you, and a connection doesn't share their phone number. To call or text them, save their number yourself.
people.failed: Some of your contacts couldn't be loaded.
people.messageNote: Message opens your messaging app with a short text you can change. It has no location in it: to send where you are, share this journey and send its link yourself.

location.heading: Where you are

accuracy.poor: Rough: it could be {meters} m off or more.
accuracy.unknown: Your phone didn't say how accurate this is.

location.stale: This is old: you may be far from here now.
location.approximate: Only your approximate location is allowed, so it can be kilometres off.
location.notAllowed: SafeRide isn't allowed to read your location. Describe where you are instead.
location.servicesOff: Your phone's location is off. Describe where you are instead.
location.notFound: Your phone didn't give a location. Try again, outdoors if you can.
location.note: SafeRide doesn't send your location to emergency services, and they can't see it here. If they ask, read these out or describe where you are: the road, the direction, a landmark.

which.title: Which service?
which.ambulance: Ambulance: someone is badly hurt, unconscious, bleeding heavily or struggling to breathe.
which.police: Police: a crash with danger on the road, a crime, a threat, or someone's safety at risk.
which.fire: Civil defence: fire, smoke, a fuel leak, or someone trapped in a vehicle.

calling.title: On the call
calling.where: Say where you are first: the road, the direction you were going, the nearest exit or landmark.
calling.stay: Stay on the line and do what the operator tells you.
calling.location: SafeRide can't make sure emergency services get your location. Tell them yourself.
calling.rely: Don't rely on SafeRide alone. If the app doesn't work, dial the number yourself.

reach.invalid: This number can't be used from SafeRide. Dial it yourself, or edit it.
reach.body: I may need assistance. Please contact me as soon as possible.

opened.title: Your messaging app opened
opened.message: Your text to {name} is ready there. Change it if you like, then send it yourself. SafeRide can't see whether it was sent.

noMessaging.title: This device can't send text messages

invalidNumber.title: This number can't be used from SafeRide
invalidNumber.message: Text {name} yourself in your messaging app.

about.title: About SafeRide
about.intro: SafeRide helps you plan safer journeys and keep your safety tools in one place. This is an early version.

stored.title: Where your information is
stored.account: Your name, email and optional phone number, in your SafeRide account. Your password is checked by Firebase Authentication; SafeRide never stores it.
stored.journeys: Your journeys and their status, in your account.
stored.route: The route of a journey you started (its points, distance and times), recorded only while it was in progress and with your permission, in your account.
stored.contacts: Your saved numbers and who you connected with, in your account. A connection shows each of you the other's name and nothing else.
stored.preferences: Your language and appearance stay on this phone.
stored.safety: If you don't answer a safety check: what kind of event it was and when, on this phone only.
stored.mapProviders: When you search or preview a route, those places go to the map services (Photon, OSRM, OpenFreeMap) that answer. Your recorded route is never sent to them.
stored.sharing: While you share, your position and what you chose to show are kept on a link anyone holding it can open, until it ends. Nothing identifies you there.

notYet.title: Not part of this version
notYet.alerts: Alerting your trusted contacts, calling emergency services, or calling anyone on your behalf.

about.deviceNote: Your account is kept on Firebase, Google's cloud service, so it follows you to another phone. Signing out or removing the app doesn't delete it; Delete account in Profile does.

offline.title: Without internet
offline.works: Works: signing in stays active, emergency numbers, the safety guide, recording a journey in progress, and the safety check.
offline.saved: Saved on this phone and sent later: journeys, contacts and route points. They can look saved before your account has them.
offline.needs: Needs a connection: signing in, creating an account, resetting a password and deleting your account. Lists show what this phone last saw.

notice.title: SafeRide is sharing your location
notice.text: Your location is sent to your private link until you stop sharing or it ends.

sharing.notEmergency: Sharing isn't an emergency service. SafeRide doesn't watch the map, and nobody is alerted.

duration.untilFinished: Until the journey finishes (at most 12 hours)

location.title: Share my location
location.intro: Create a private link that shows where you are, live, to the people you send it to. They don't need an account.

journey.title: Share this journey
journey.intro: Create a private link that shows this journey, live, to the people you send it to. They don't need an account. It stops when the journey ends.

start.seesTitle: Anyone with the link can see

sees.position: Where you are now, and when that was last updated
sees.ends: The journey's start and destination, in your own words
sees.route: The route recorded so far, and the distance travelled
sees.status: Whether sharing is live, paused or finished

start.never: Your name, email, phone number, contacts, other journeys or safety checks.
start.privacy: This link works for anyone who has it, until it ends. Send it only to people you trust.

delivery.notReaching: Updates aren't getting through right now

manage.title: Manage sharing
manage.journey: You're sharing this journey: your location, its start and destination, and its route.

stopConfirm.title: Stop sharing?
stopConfirm.body: The link stops working. What someone has already seen can't be taken back.

manage.privacy: Anyone with this link can see it until it ends. Stopping ends the link, but can't erase what was already seen, screenshots included.

stopped.title: Sharing stopped
stopped.offline: Nothing more is being sent. The link ends once you're back online, or at its end time.

offline.title: No connection
offline.body: Sharing needs a connection to start. Nothing was shared.

unavailable.title: Sharing isn't available yet
unavailable.body: A link couldn't be confirmed to work, so none was created. Nothing was shared.

refused.title: Sharing couldn't start
refused.body: The server refused it. Check that your phone's date and time are correct.

noAccess.title: Location is needed
noAccess.body: Allow precise location for SafeRide to share where you are.

alreadySharing.title: Already sharing
alreadySharing.body: Stop the current share before starting another.

notActive.title: This journey isn't in progress
notActive.body: Only a journey in progress can be shared.

status.offline: You're offline: not up to date

ended.title: This share has ended
ended.body: It was stopped or it expired, or the link isn't valid.

unreachable.title: Can't load this share
unreachable.body: Check your connection and open the link again.
